title: The US FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy its "Starmind" constellation of 1M satellites for data centers in space (David Shepardson/Reuters)
summary: David Shepardson / Reuters: The US FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy its “Starmind” constellation of 1M satellites for data centers in space — The Federal Communications Commission on Wednesday said it was authorizing Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPCX.O) to deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space.
